answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. It survives because finality only counts for established attestators, so a fresh cluster cannot push transactions until it proves honesty across many epochs.
